title: Resident doctors at Government Medical College in Srinagar go on indefinite strike

ai.summary: Postgraduate and senior resident doctors at Government Medical College in Srinagar began an indefinite strike demanding stipend hikes and parity with other states and union territories.

facts.claim: Postgraduate and senior resident doctors at the Government Medical College in Srinagar began an indefinite strike on Friday (November 20, 2026)
facts.quote: Postgraduate and senior resident doctors at the Government Medical College in Srinagar began an indefinite strike on Friday (November 20, 2026)

facts.claim: The protesting doctors urged the government to address their demands immediately
facts.quote: The protesting doctors urged the government to address their demands immediately.

facts.claim: The government must address the long-pending stipend grievances without further delay
facts.quote: "The government must address the long-pending stipend grievances without further delay," All India Medical Students' Association (AIMSA) vice president, Dr. Mohit Choudhary, a PG resident at Government Medical College (GMC) Srinagar, said.

facts.claim: AIMSA's key demands include immediate stipend enhancement and parity for postgraduate, senior resident, DNB and MDS doctors across Jammu and Kashmir, besides implementation of maternity leave benefits in accordance with applicable High Court directions
facts.quote: AIMSA's key demands include immediate stipend enhancement and parity for postgraduate, senior resident, DNB and MDS doctors across Jammu and Kashmir, besides implementation of maternity leave benefits in accordance with applicable High Court directions.

facts.claim: They also urged the principal of GMC Srinagar to facilitate the formation of a recognised Resident Doctors' Association (RDA) to ensure proper representation of resident doctors
facts.quote: They also urged the principal of GMC Srinagar to facilitate the formation of a recognised Resident Doctors' Association (RDA) to ensure proper representation of resident doctors.

ai.background_note: Doctors at Government Medical College in Srinagar started an indefinite strike in November 2026 demanding higher stipends and parity with other states and union territories.
